name: Cell Shock
source:
The story takes place after the events of "System Shock 2". John Vattik is now alone on the ship and waits for the other surviving crew members to come back to the Von-Braun with the escape shuttle.
His aim is to go home again after all that happened…

[Edited from Official page]
translation:
故事发生在《网络奇兵2》事件之后。约翰·瓦蒂克现在独自一人在船上，等待其他幸存的船员乘坐逃生航天飞机返回冯·布劳恩号。
他的目标是在发生了这一切之后再次回家……

[编辑自官方页面]
